description: Monitoring the Quantity of Water Flowing Through the Upper Mekong Basin Under Natural (Unimpeded) Conditions is a dataset listed in Open Development Mekong data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Open Development Mekong. This study developed a reliable and simple model that predicts the natural flow of the Upper Mekong, then used this prediction to determine how the cascade of dams built on the Upper Mekong is altering the natural flow of the river. Coverage: the Mekong region (Cambodia, Laos, Myanmar, Thailand, Vietnam). The portal files it under the publisher Open Development Mekong. Its tags are Climate change, Drought, Hydropower dams, Water policy and administration. It offers 2 resource(s) in pdf, zip. The portal shows 2020-04-24 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odm-portal.
